entries.zh: 高抬贵手，从宽放过；宽纵
entries.en: to let someone off lightly; to be lenient (lit. "put the hand high")
entries.notes: R 栏空缺；H 为比喻性熟语，依 M 音写与 L 栏 perdonar 推其宽纵义。

entries.en: to pardon, to absolve (a sin or offence)
to pardon and forgive; to grant clemency
to make allowances; to be lenient in view of the circumstances
entries.notes: H「量情」为依情酌量之义，与 L 栏 perdonar 属引申对应。

entries.zh: 烦劳，叨扰（客套语：劳您费心）
entries.en: to trouble someone; "pray, do not trouble yourself"
entries.notes: L 栏 perdonar 在此为客套「请见谅」，H 取「劳烦」之谦敬义。

entries.en: to make an accommodation; to remit part of a debt
entries.notes: L 栏明言宽免部分债款，H「曲处」取委曲通融义，M 音写与 H 相合。

entries.zh: 初犯宽让：初次犯错便饶过他
entries.en: to let a first offender off; to pardon a first offence
entries.notes: L 栏西语残损难读，释义依 H/M 栏「初犯让伊」。

entries.en: to make do; to put up with; to stretch a point
entries.notes: L 栏后半「per dono q pogora」残损，释义依 H/M 栏。

entries.en: to atone for a fault by meritorious service; to make amends
〔text defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏「per donar, çufis」不可读，H 栏「镜/销」有疑，M 音写无确解，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 将心比心，设身处地体谅
entries.en: to put oneself in another's place; to be considerate
entries.notes: L 栏后半文句错乱，H/M 栏「将心」为「将心比心」之省。

entries.en: to grant exemption; to remit by favour
to forgive and give way; to be forbearing
entries.notes: H「恕让」为并列复合，L 栏 perdonar 只及其半，故降一等。

entries.zh: 看情面宽免；因人说情而赦
entries.en: to pardon at someone's intercession; to forgive for someone's sake
entries.notes: H 栏「纳/讷」有疑，M 栏「lǎpsý」音写不全，释义半依 L 栏 intercesión 推定。

entries.zh: 招安，特赦归顺（对反叛者的一般宽赦）
entries.en: general pardon; amnesty offered to those who submit
to bear with one another; mutual forbearance

entries.zh: 起动，劳驾（客套：不敢劳动您）
entries.en: to put someone to trouble; "pray do not trouble yourself"
entries.notes: M 栏作「quy.fang.a.」且无调号，音写不整；H 取「起动」谦敬义。

entries.en: to disturb, to trouble (polite apology for intrusion)
to perish; to be ruined; to die
entries.notes: H 单字「沦」取「沦亡、沦没」义，方与 L 栏 perecer/morir 相当。

entries.en: lazy; a lazy fellow, sluggard
entries.notes: L 栏字形「Perepon」疑为 perezoso/perezón 之讹，释义依 H/M 栏「懒」。
